# OPTIMA

> OPTIMA is a web-based SEO audit tool. A user submits one web page URL, and OPTIMA analyzes its on-page SEO, mobile performance, and technical crawlability, returning results in plain English.

## What OPTIMA checks

OPTIMA runs the following checks on a submitted page:

- Title tag and meta description
- H1 count and heading structure
- Image alt text and approximate body word count
- Canonical URL and internal/external links
- HTTPS, meta robots, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml
- Mobile viewport configuration
- Google PageSpeed mobile performance: LCP, INP/TBT, and CLS

## What a user receives after running an audit

- An overall score from 0-100
- Category scores for on-page SEO, performance, and technical health
- Issues grouped by severity (critical, warning, passed) with plain-English explanations
- A downloadable PDF report

Audit results are shown only in the user's current session. They are not published as crawlable result pages, and submitted URLs are not stored or shared.

## What OPTIMA is not

OPTIMA is an automated starting point for a technical SEO review of a single page. It does not perform keyword research, backlink analysis, content strategy, or full-site crawling, and it does not replace an SEO specialist's judgment.

## Primary pages

- Homepage and audit tool: https://optima-arch.vercel.app/
- Scoring guide (how the 0-100 score is calculated): https://optima-arch.vercel.app/scoring
- Sitemap: https://optima-arch.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
